definitions.explanation: The total amount of money received from selling goods or services over a given period. A key financial metric used in accounting and business reporting.

examples.japanese: {売上高|うりあげだか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売上高|うりあげだか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{過去最高|かこさいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: This year's total sales set an all-time record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{連結|れんけつ}→連結：14388_renketsu⟧{売上高|うりあげだか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前年比|ぜんねんひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧{増|ぞう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一兆円|いっちょうえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: Consolidated revenue reached one trillion yen, a ten percent increase year on year.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧ (sales) + {高|だか} (amount, volume). The suffix {高|だか} indicates a total amount or volume.

USAGE:
{売上高|うりあげだか} is a formal financial term used in corporate earnings reports, accounting statements, and business news. In everyday conversation, {売|う}り{上|あ}げ is more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {売|う}り{上|あ}げ: sales, revenue (less formal, broader usage)
- ⟦{収益|しゅうえき}→収益：06302_shuueki⟧: earnings, profit
- ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧: profit (what remains after expenses)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売上高|うりあげだか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧: sales grow
- ⟦{連結|れんけつ}→連結：14388_renketsu⟧{売上高|うりあげだか}: consolidated revenue
- {年間|ねんかん}{売上高|うりあげだか}: annual sales
- {売上高|うりあげだか}{営業利益率|えいぎょうりえきりつ}: operating profit margin
